summary: The authors analyzed individual P21 offspring libraries separately by sex. HypoExplorer sums the same 9 control and 6 exposed male libraries into three litters per arm before estimating the benzene effect. The published figures, supplements and public deposits yielded no gene-level author result for that litter-level contrast. The proposal leaves concordance unassessed.
openIssues: Reopen if the authors release gene-level benzene-versus-air effects for the same six male litter aggregates, with identifiers and library-to-litter mapping.
The PMC supplement link returned a challenge. The publisher and preprint supplements were both inspected and contained glial imaging and body-composition figures.
SOURCES.tsv inventories all 40 downloaded files and their verified SHA-256 hashes. The evidence folder is present locally and excluded by Git.
